skill.name: landing-page-design

content.value_statement: Visitors leave when a landing page communicates value poorly or presents competing actions. This skill provides practical rules for clear structure, persuasive copy, responsive design, and focused conversion paths.
actual_capabilities: Plans an above-the-fold section with a headline, subheadline, primary action, outcome-focused image, and social proof.
Creates headline and call-to-action options using defined conversion formulas.
Orders page sections from the hero through proof, features, pricing, objections, and final action.
Reviews forms, mobile layouts, image sizing, and page performance against practical guidelines.
Provides belt CLI examples for image generation, web research, and social sharing images.
Identifies common landing page mistakes and recommends focused corrections.
limitations: The skill provides design guidance but does not build, deploy, or test a complete website.
Generated visuals and research require the external belt CLI, an account, and network access.
Conversion benchmarks and traffic claims should be verified before publication.
The guidance cannot guarantee conversion gains without analytics and controlled testing.

use_cases.title: Launch a SaaS Product Page
use_cases.description: Create a focused page structure, outcome-led hero, product proof, pricing flow, and trial action.

use_cases.title: Improve a Campaign Landing Page
use_cases.description: Review headlines, calls to action, forms, and social proof before sending paid traffic.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Responsive Design Brief
use_cases.description: Define desktop and mobile requirements for layout, tap targets, image behavior, and page speed.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Hero Section
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a landing page hero for [product]. The audience is [audience], the main problem is [problem], and the desired action is [action].
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when starting a new page and the core offer is already defined.

prompt_templates.title: Plan the Full Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a complete landing page for [offer]. Include section order, one primary action, social proof needs, form fields, mobile behavior, and visual recommendations.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when a team needs a structured page brief before design or development.

prompt_templates.title: Audit an Existing Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this landing page content: [content]. Identify unclear value, competing actions, weak proof, form friction, mobile risks, and specific corrections.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when improving an existing page before a campaign or release.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Conversion Test Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a prioritized test plan for [page]. Use [analytics summary] and [customer evidence]. Define hypotheses, variants, success metrics, risks, and visual asset needs.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when analytics and customer evidence are available for advanced optimization.

output_examples.input: Create a hero for an automated documentation product used by software teams.
output: Headline: Ship accurate documentation in minutes.
Subheadline: Turn code changes into clear, current guides without maintaining manual templates.
Primary action: Create your first guide.
Visual direction: Show a developer reviewing completed documentation beside a successful build.

output_examples.input: Audit a signup page with two primary buttons and six required form fields.
output_examples.output: Choose one primary action, move the secondary option to a text link, and reduce required fields to the minimum needed for account creation.

output_examples.input: Plan the mobile requirements for a campaign landing page.
output: Use a full-width primary action with a stable tap target.
Keep the headline and action visible early in the page.
Prevent horizontal overflow and serve responsive images.
Use readable input text and immediate validation.

best_practices: Define one measurable visitor action before writing copy or arranging sections.
Use real customer evidence for testimonials, counts, ratings, and performance claims.
Validate the page on mobile devices and test changes with reliable analytics.
anti_patterns: Do not use vague headlines that describe technology without stating a customer outcome.
Do not present several actions with equal visual priority.
Do not publish invented testimonials, logos, ratings, urgency, or conversion statistics.

faq.question: Does this skill create a complete website?
faq.answer: No. It provides page structure, copy guidance, visual direction, and review criteria for designers and developers.

faq.question: Can it improve an existing landing page?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the current content, audience, offer, desired action, and available performance evidence.

faq.question: Does it generate images?
faq.answer: It includes belt CLI examples for hosted image generation. This requires installation, authentication, network access, and user approval.

faq.question: Is the guidance suitable for mobile pages?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers responsive images, tap targets, readable forms, overflow prevention, and early placement of the primary action.

faq.question: Will these recommendations guarantee more conversions?
faq.answer: No. Results depend on the offer, audience, traffic quality, implementation, measurement, and testing.

faq.question: What information produces the best result?
faq.answer: Provide the product, audience, customer problem, desired action, proof, constraints, brand direction, and current analytics.
